data.text: [00:05]Hi Marcos, what are you doing next Thursday? `[00:09]And your brother too ... is he around?
[00:12.6]Erm ... next Thursday? `[00:15]Ermm ... my brother is staying with friends next week ... but I’m not doing anything. Why?
[00:23]Well, I’m having a meal at my house to celebrate Thanksgiving and I’d really like you to come.
[00:30.6]Oh, thanks, I’d love to! `[00:33]That’s very kind of you!
[00:39]So, is there anything I can bring?

[00:41]Oh, no! Don’t worry about that. `[00:43]Just come and enjoy yourself. `[00:44.6]We’re eating at about two o’clock in the afternoon – so why don’t you come at about midday for some drinks first?
[00:53]Perfect! `[00:54]See you then ... I’m really looking forward to it ...
